name: LLMs.txt Sitemap Manager
author: Sandalia Apps

sections.description:
LLMs.txt Sitemap Manager automatically generates an LLMs.txt file — a structured, lightweight list of important public URLs from your site — specifically designed for Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and other AI systems.

Think of it as a traditional XML sitemap but optimized for AI agents to read, understand, and learn from your website content.

Key Benefits:
– ✅ Future-proof your site for AI discovery
– ✅ Lightweight, automatic, and customizable
– ✅ No manual configuration needed

New: AI Crawler Detection
Track whether major AI bots like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot are reading your LLMs.txt files.

Features

  • Automatic LLMs.txt generation
  • Custom post type selection and ordering
  • Integration with popular SEO plugins (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO)
  • Sitemap integration for improved discoverability
  • Cache management for performance
  • Configurable update frequency
  • AI crawler detection to monitor bot activity
  • FAQ section for quick guidance

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings under Settings → LLMs.txt Sitemap Manager
sections.faq:
What is LLMs.txt?

LLMs.txt is a simple, structured file that lists public URLs from your site to help AI models like ChatGPT understand and discover your content.

Does it integrate with SEO plugins?

Yes! LLMs.txt Sitemap Manager works seamlessly with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and AIOSEO, automatically excluding content marked as noindex or nofollow.

Can I customize which posts appear?

Absolutely! You can select post types, order them, and configure how frequently the file updates.
